rows.grounds: instrumental of compound māyā-bīja; māyā-bīja denotes the seed syllable associated with māyā
instrumental compound specifying the seed as hrīṃ; hrīṃ is a bīja syllable kept transliterated
demonstrative with noun referring to the water to be consecrated
optative expressing ritual injunction to empower with mantra

items.question: Which mantra seed syllables are required to consecrate the ritual water?
premises: Ritual water requires consecration by mantra.
The māyā seed is prescribed for this consecration.
The seed syllable hrīṃ is identified as that bīja.
items.inference: Therefore one should consecrate that water with the māyā seed, namely hrīṃ.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat+jalaṃ depends on the immediately preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: One should consecrate that water with the māyā-seed, the seed syllable hrīṃ.
